$comment: Merged over bundles/workflow/skills/verify/references/verify.json. The hub is its own source, so its skills live under bundles/, not .agents/.

steps.name: format
steps.why: lint-staged formats what a commit touches. A file written by a script or an agent that bypassed the hook shows up here.

steps.name: bundles
steps.why: Every bundle config must resolve: unknown include, missing rule script, include cycle.

steps.name: agents lock
steps.why: Every dir in .agents/skills has a pin and every pin a dir. A dead pin resurfaces on the next sync.
